scope: All cached bytes searched for RIP disp32 candidates; complete native instruction decoding validates retained references. Global-enable cell only retains common direct write opcodes; per-hook cell retains all RIP references. This is not an exhaustive proof against indirect or external writes.

minimum_observation.required_recheck: Re-read both exact bytes and source instruction guards after the callback; reject changed values or image identity.
minimum_observation.rejects_unresolved_branch: Both nonzero: callback dispatcher can set hook state2 and skip the native byte; pre-call state alone does not approve the callback branch.
